systems.tiers: issued initially only in Libreville (July 2024), with plans to extend to all police stations nationwide

systems.country_label: Numéro d'Identification Personnel (NIP); called a civil registry issuance campaign by the article
systems.tiers: registration centres set up in the Libreville region from May 2024 to issue the NIP needed for the CNIE

systems.platform: awarded in 2012 to Thales Digital Identity Security; cards later contracted to Semlex, contract reportedly terminated; Thales reported as taking over

note: The article's 'civil registry issuance campaign' is enrolment for the personal identification number (class identity), not registration of births or deaths; no fact for the civil sub-indicator.
